_metadata.description: Typed all-kind structural intelligence (deterministic offender rollups across the nine repository target kinds).

requirements.title: Aggregate fleet conformance and distributions
requirements.description: FleetService.ScanFleet rolls up offenders, profile/surface distribution, per-rule conformance, and auto-fixable coverage across typed repository targets via deterministic structured queries — not a search-hub data provider.

validation.notes: fleet/fleet_test.go asserts the scan aggregates rollups and distributions and requires a validation engine.

requirements.title: Fleet scan is resilient to per-scenario errors
requirements.description: A target that fails to scan is recorded as an error and the fleet scan continues over the remaining typed targets rather than aborting the whole rollup.

validation.notes: fleet/fleet_test.go asserts a failing scenario is recorded and the scan continues.

requirements.title: Enumerate and roll up all repository target kinds
requirements.description: The fleet scanner enumerates scenario, resource, tool, safeguard, package, control-plane, docs, team, and project targets, preserves their kind/id/path identity, and exposes typed rollups through the FleetService RPC.

validation.notes: fleet/fleet_test.go asserts all nine target kinds are enumerated and retained in deterministic order; the Structure Health CLI reachability test covers every declared kind.
Live `structure-health validate all --path . --json` traversed scenario, resource, tool, safeguard, team, package, control-plane, docs, and project targets.

requirements.title: Project authority and deterministic remediation are represented
requirements.description: Project structural findings use the repository contract allowlist, map into the cross-kind maturity ladder, and expose deterministic project allowlist remediation through the shared dry-run-first autofix registry with idempotent apply behavior.

validation.notes: autofix/autofix_test.go proves PROJECT_CONFIG_SURFACE preview, apply, and second-apply no-op behavior.
The provider descriptor validation proves every emitted target-pack code has a maturity mapping and explicit remediation classification.
